name: jaredsburrows-com
description: Type checking, CI tests, and one build step: static/js/*.ts compiles to the *.js the browser downloads. Nothing else is compiled or bundled.
//type: MUST stay commonjs. .github/validate-*.ts use require(); 'module' here would break all three validators, and they are what gate every deploy. The .mts files are ESM by extension and are unaffected either way.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.jsdom.json

//build: static/js/*.js is GENERATED from the .ts beside it and committed, because Cloudflare serves this directory as-is. Never hand-edit static/js/*.js -- edit the .ts and run `npm run build`. CI fails if the two disagree.
